questions.questionText: Which one of the following is an example of government failure due to unintended consequences?
options: A government target to increase police officers is missed due to a low number of applicants
Government provision of a free flu vaccine for the over 60s has a low take-up
The government cancels a plan for a new railway line after an expensive planning enquiry
The government introduces a charge at a waste disposal site which leads to illegal dumping

questions.questionText: In 2015, the UK government introduced a tax on firms using landfill sites to dispose of waste. After the tax was introduced, there was a significant rise in illegal dumping of waste. This is most likely to be an example of
options: government failure due to unintended consequences.
market failure resulting from imperfect information.

questions.questionText: Evaluate the view that government failure means that government intervention in markets will rarely lead to an improvement in economic welfare.
Government failure must have occurred when government intervention
options: reduces total welfare in the economy.

questions.questionText: A government builds a new road to reduce traffic congestion on existing roads. This project would inevitably result in government failure if
options: local residents raised environmental objections to the new road.
the cost of the new road was twice as large as the original estimate.
the reduction in traffic congestion was smaller than forecast.
total benefits from the new road were less than the cost of the new road.
